<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 400" width="600" height="400">
  <defs>
    <!-- Background Gradient -->
    <radialGradient id="bg-grad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="75%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f0f4f0" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- 3D Globe Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="globe-grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d1e7d6" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#1a7a3a" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Amber Glow for Target -->
    <radialGradient id="amber-glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#d97706" stop-opacity="0.4" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#d97706" stop-opacity="0" />
    </radialGradient>

    <!-- Card Glass Gradient -->
    <linearGradient id="glass-grad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.9" />
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0.4" />
    </linearGradient>

    <!-- Clipping Paths -->
    <clipPath id="clip-globe">
      <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="105" />
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id="clip-mountains">
      <path d="M 60 380 L 130 260 L 175 340 L 220 260 L 310 380 Z" />
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id="clip-card">
      <rect x="380" y="240" width="140" height="110" rx="12" />
    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id="clip-graph">
      <rect x="380" y="240" width="140" height="110" rx="12" />
    </clipPath>
  </defs>

  <!-- Base Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="url(#bg-grad)" />

  <!-- Animated Dashed Rings -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="200" r="150" fill="none" stroke="#d1e7d6" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="6 6" opacity="0.6">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 300 200" to="360 300 200" dur="60s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>
  <circle cx="300" cy="200" r="195" fill="none" stroke="#d1e7d6" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="8 8" opacity="0.4">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="360 300 200" to="0 300 200" dur="80s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </circle>

  <!-- Ambient Data Grid Lines -->
  <path d="M -40 100 Q 300 180 640 60" fill="none" stroke="#d1e7d6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 8" opacity="0.8" />
  <path d="M 660 300 Q 300 220 -40 340" fill="none" stroke="#d1e7d6" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4 8" opacity="0.8" />

  <!-- ================= 3D GEOSPHERE ================= -->
  <g id="geosphere" transform="translate(0, 10)">
    <!-- Amber Crosshair/Glow Behind Globe -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="25" fill="url(#amber-glow)">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="25; 32; 25" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="45" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="45; 52; 45" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.6; 0.1; 0.6" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="60" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.3">
      <animate attributeName="r" values="60; 70; 60" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    </circle>
    
    <!-- Crosshair Lines -->
    <line x1="280" y1="210" x2="320" y2="210" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5" />
    <line x1="300" y1="190" x2="300" y2="230" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5" />

    <!-- Main Globe Base -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="105" fill="url(#globe-grad)" />
    
    <!-- Globe Clipped Surface Details -->
    <g clip-path="url(#clip-globe)">
      <!-- Data Latitude & Longitude Lines -->
      <path d="M 195 210 A 105 35 0 0 0 405 210" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7" />
      <path d="M 195 210 A 105 35 0 0 1 405 210" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5" />
      <path d="M 195 180 A 105 70 0 0 0 405 180" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4" />
      <path d="M 300 105 L 300 315" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7" />
      <path d="M 270 108 L 270 312" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5" />
      <path d="M 330 108 L 330 312" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.5" />
      <path d="M 240 120 L 240 300" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4" />
      <path d="M 360 120 L 360 300" fill="none" stroke="#1a7a3a" stroke-width="1" opacity="0.4" />

      <!-- Abstract Landmass / Data Blobs -->
      <path d="M 220 180 Q 260 160 290 190 T 330 210 T 270 250 T 210 220 Z" fill="#f0f4f0" opacity="0.25" />
      <path d="M 320 140 Q 360 130 380 170 T 340 190 Z" fill="#f0f4f0" opacity="0.25" />
      <path d="M 210 260 Q 240 280 280 260 T 250 230 Z" fill="#f0f4f0" opacity="0.25" />
      
      <!-- Bottom Hemisphere Darkening Overlay for 3D effect -->
      <rect x="195" y="210" width="210" height="105" fill="#1e293b" opacity="0.15" />
    </g>

    <!-- Edge Highlight for 3D Sphere effect -->
    <circle cx="300" cy="210" r="105" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="3" opacity="0.6" />
    <path d="M 210 140 Q 300 90 390 140" fill="none" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.5" />
  </g>

  <!-- Card 1: Mountains (Left) -->

    <rect x="40" y="240" width="140" height="110" rx="12" fill="url(#glass-grad)" stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="2" filter="drop-shadow(0px 8px 12px rgba(26, 122, 58, 0.15))" />

        <animate attributeName="x2" values="310; 350; 310" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
        <animate attributeName="y2" values="260; 140; 260" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
